lines.t: We wandered far from the ancient way
Chasing dust that could not stay
The world made promises it never kept
Left our hearts bruised, our hearts bent
Yet in the silence a voice still burned a fire
A troop to which we turned from broken ground
Drowned from shattered years, we heard his call cut through our fear.
The night did not overcome the flame, the dark could not hide his name.
Mercy strong, in love made known, he called the lost, the weary, and led us home.
Yahushua, light of truth and grace
You made us in our fallen place
With wounded hands you lifted the lowly
Loved us more than we could ever know
Yahushua, faithful, true and kind
You heal the heart, you free the mind
We return undone and broken
Alive again within your love
We tasted gold that turned to dust
Built our lives on broken trust
Crowns of pride, thrones of sand
Fell apart within our hands
But you stood firm when all gave way
The living word who does not sway
Truth embodied me, get strong You waited patiently, all alone
You did not turn your face away You bore the weight, you paved the way
Your voice still calls, across time Arise, return, you are mine
Yahushua, light of truth and grace
You met us in our fallen place
With wounded hands you lifted the lowly
Loved us more than we could ever know
Yahushua, shepherd of the lost
You paid it for the dreadful cause
We lay our crowns before your throne
No longer ours, we are your own
From the beginning, you were the Word
By heaven formed, by earth unheard
You spoke and life came rushing in
You spoke and hope was born again
You are the way the prophets saw
The promised King, the living Lord
Not bound by time, not ruled by death
Eternal fire, eternal breath
Yahushua, King of kings above
Clothed in power, crowned in love
Every knee will bow in truth
Every tongue confess your rule
Yahushua, morning star arise
Shatter night before our eyes
We stand restored, redeemed, made new
All glory, honor, praise to you
From age to age, your word remains
Unshaken truth, unbroken name
We live, we stand, we overcome
By the Lamb
By the Holy One
We'll see you next time.
